slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Not covered here? Ask us directly — same working day response.

slots.label: Question 1
slots.default: What is IT support, and why do I need it?

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: IT support covers the services that keep your business technology maintained, troubleshot and improved. From fixing hardware issues and managing software updates to cyber security, it keeps your business operating smoothly without downtime.

slots.label: Question 2
slots.default: How quickly can I get help when I have an IT issue?

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: We categorise faults into priority groups. P1 faults require immediate attention and are reserved for major incidents where your whole business is unable to operate, such as an internet outage. Priorities range from P1 down to P5, each with its own SLA that dictates how quickly we respond to and resolve the fault.

slots.label: Question 3
slots.default: Do you work with smaller teams?

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: Yes. We shape the service around your team size, so you get the same tooling, security and response times whatever your headcount.

slots.label: Question 4
slots.default: How do you onboard new clients?

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: Our onboarding process is simple. We start with a thorough assessment of your current IT systems and business needs, create a customised support plan, install any tooling needed for remote assistance, and begin supporting your business. It really is that simple.

slots.label: Question 5
slots.default: What makes you different from other managed service providers?

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: We’re a small, family-run managed service provider that prioritises exceptional service above all else. Unlike larger providers with thousands of clients, we build strong relationships and provide personalised IT support with care, attention and a tailored approach.

slots.label: Question 6
slots.default: How do I get started with your IT support services?

slots.label: Paragraph 7
slots.default: Simply contact us for a free consultation and we’ll assess your IT needs and recommend the best support package for your business.
